resolution.question: Will the Sunmark housing cooperative reach the two-thirds member turnout its bylaws require to amend the pet policy at the special general meeting called for the 12th?
resolution.resolution: Resolve YES only if the persistent event history shows that at least two-thirds of all members (or their valid proxies) were recorded as present at the special general meeting by the cutoff time of 2026-09-12T22:00:00+02:00. Otherwise resolve NO.
